_comment: The three operator income models. Derived from knowledge/02-income-models.md (last_verified 2026-07-11) and lib/offers.ts. Ranges are honest and hedged on purpose — no invented stats, no income promises.

models.name: Productized Implementation — Agent-as-a-Service
models.summary: Customer job: Deploy custom AI agent workflows for your team. We scope, test, and deliver repo-committed code with human gates, while client teams maintain authority.
models.timeToFirstDollar: scoped implementation sprint — fixed 2-day or custom timeframe based on acceptance checks
models.upfrontCost: fixed implementation scope — no hidden recurring fees or unverified costs
models.laborProfile: delivery-bounded: scoped deliverables, concrete test suites, and explicit human approval gates before production execution
models.failureMode: unbounded scope creep — clear boundaries, non-goals, and acceptance criteria prevent misaligned expectations

models.name: Digital Products — Self-Serve Blueprints & Kits
models.summary: Customer job: Install production-proven agent architectures, prompt packs, and starter kits self-serve via merchant of record.
models.timeToFirstDollar: instant self-serve delivery — access blueprints and starter code immediately upon availability
models.upfrontCost: one-time digital product price — complete with source code, schemas, and usage docs
models.laborProfile: self-directed implementation: executable assets, automated schemas, and step-by-step guides
models.failureMode: lack of maintenance — products carry explicit versioning and maintenance promises to prevent staleness

models.name: Selective Affiliate & Open Core — Verified Proof Systems
models.summary: Customer job: Inspect open-source reference implementations and query verified partner economics without hidden incentives.
models.timeToFirstDollar: open access & verified partner tables — inspectable MIT code and dated commission terms
models.upfrontCost: zero cost for open-core skills — MIT-licensed skills and schemas you can run locally
models.laborProfile: transparent research: disclosed partner recommendations and quarterly re-verified terms
models.failureMode: undisclosed incentives — every compensated destination is explicitly labeled with non-affiliate alternatives
